_comment: weight = relative compute capacity per backend; load is normalized by it so a faster machine takes proportionally more traffic. mem_soft_floor/mem_penalty are the soft memory gate (deprioritize a backend near its Metal ceiling, never hard-exclude). affinity_hysteresis is in weight-normalized load units.

aliases._comment: optional: map a client-facing display alias to the real model id from /v1/models/status
